title: Enhanced UHPLC-MS/MS screening of selective androgen receptor modulators following urine hydrolysis
author: Gadaj, Ventura, et al.

steps.title: Store and centrifuge urine
steps.instruction: Keep urine samples frozen at –80 °C until analysis, then thaw and centrifuge at 4 500 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Assess SG and adjust pH
steps.instruction: Measure urinary specific gravity and, if needed, adjust the pH to 5.5 ± 0.1 using acetic acid.

steps.title: Add internal standard
steps.instruction: Aliquot 200 µL of each urine sample into a tube and add 20 µL of a 50 ng mL⁻¹ internal‑standard mix.

steps.title: Add acetate buffer
steps.instruction: After 15 min, add 200 µL of 0.1 mol L⁻¹ acetate buffer (pH 5.5) and vortex for 10 s.

steps.title: Add enzyme solution
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of β‑glucuronidase/arylsulfatase (diluted 1:5 with water), vortex for 10 s.

steps.title: Incubate enzymatic hydrolysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture in a shaking water bath at 55 °C for 1 h, then allow to cool for approximately 10 min.

steps.title: Adjust pH with NH4OH
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 50 mmol L⁻¹ aqueous NH₄OH (pH 10.5), vortex for 60 s.

steps.title: Extract with TBME
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of tert‑butyl‑methyl‑ether (TBME) and vortex for 15 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge extraction mixture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 24 400 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant and evaporate
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear supernatant to a 2 mL micro‑tube and evaporate to dryness under nitrogen (≤5 Bar) at 40 °C using a Turbovap® LV system.

steps.title: Reconstitute dried residue
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the residue in 100 µL H₂O:MeCN (4:1, v/v) and vortex for 5 min.

steps.title: Filter reconstituted extract
steps.instruction: Filter the extract by centrifugation at 10 840 × g for 2 min at 15 °C.

steps.title: Inject sample into UHPLC‑MS/MS
steps.instruction: Inject 9 µL of the filtered extract onto the UHPLC‑MS/MS system.

steps.title: Configure UHPLC chromatographic conditions
steps.instruction: Install a Luna® Omega Polar C18 column (100 × 2.1 mm, 1.6 µm) with KrudKatcher™ Ultra inline filter. Set flow rate to 0.40 mL min⁻¹, injection volume 9 µL, and apply the following gradient (mobile phase A: 0.1 % v/v CH₃COOH in H₂O; mobile phase B: 0.1 % v/v CH₃COOH in MeOH): 0.00 min 20 % B; 0.50 min 20 % B; 4.75 min 60 % B; 10.50 min 67.5 % B; 11.00 min 99 % B; 12.00 min 99 % B; 12.10 min 20 % B; 14.00 min 20 % B. Divert flow to waste from 11.00 to 13.50 min. Use needle wash (H₂O:MeOH 1:1) and purge (H₂O:MeOH 4:1); seal wash H₂O:MeOH 95:5.

steps.title: Set MS/MS detection parameters
steps.instruction: Program the Xevo® TQ‑MS with capillary voltage 2.50 kV (ESI +) and 1.00 kV (ESI –), source temperature 120 °C, desolvation temperature 550 °C, desolvation gas flow 900 L h⁻¹, collision gas flow 0.15 mL min⁻¹. For each analyte, set cone voltage, collision energy and SRM transitions as listed in Table 2, and apply the SRM acquisition windows specified (e.g., SRM 1 6.80‑7.40 min, SRM 2 4.40‑5.00 min, …).

description: The current assay was validated with regard to selectivity, specificity, detection capability (CCβ), sensitivity, limit of detection (LOD), absolute recovery and matrix effects, according to respective EU legislation [14,15] to demonstrate compliance with required performance criteria. Validation was carried out at the screening target concentration (Cval) of 1 ng mL−1 excluding andarine (2 ng mL−1) and BMS-564929 (5 ng mL−1) as detailed in Ventura et al. [5].
